description.fun: A small blue monkey with a toxic chain wrapped round its head like a twisted headband. Legend says it was once clumsy and dim-witted, and its longing for brains led it to Pecharunt, whose chain stimulated its mind until psychic powers bloomed, even letting it see a little way into the future. Now it stays somewhere safe and toys with foes, making them dizzy with psychokinesis.
description.guide: A Poison and Psychic-type Legendary Pokémon from The Teal Mask, one of Pecharunt's Loyal Three with Okidogi and Fezandipiti. The toxic chain around its head awakened its psychic powers. Its name combines 'monkey' and 'hunky-dory'.
description.tagline: A sly monkey whose toxic headband made it a psychic
